say.never: Turn the comment above into code, as a table. Write `switch (system_state_)` with a `case` for IDLE, SPIN_UP and SHOOT. Inside each one, write `switch (wanted)`. Then fill in the rows: from IDLE, `case SHOOT:` sets `system_state_` to SPIN_UP. From SPIN_UP, `case SHOOT:` sets it to SHOOT only `if (isAtSpeed())`, and `case IDLE:` sets it to IDLE. From SHOOT, `case SHOOT:` goes back to SPIN_UP `if (hasDipped())`, and `case IDLE:` sets it to IDLE. Every inner switch ends with `default: break;`, which means "ignore anything else". Don't forget a `break;` after each inner switch too.
say.bit: Turn the comment above it into a table: `switch (system_state_)`, and inside each case `switch (wanted)`. Rows: IDLE wanting SHOOT goes to SPIN_UP; SPIN_UP wanting SHOOT goes to SHOOT once `isAtSpeed()`, wanting IDLE goes to IDLE; SHOOT wanting SHOOT goes back to SPIN_UP if `hasDipped()`, wanting IDLE goes to IDLE. `default: break;` ignores the rest.

say.never: Write a `switch` with one `case` for each state. IDLE stops both motors. SPIN_UP calls `runFlywheel()` and leaves the roller stopped. SHOOT calls `runFlywheel()` and also runs the roller at `CONSTANTS.INDEX_DUTY_CYCLE`. The three lines are listed in the comment.
